usedFor: Quora Lead Gen Forms holds new leads, and HubSpot stores them through “Create or Update Contact”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Lead” in Quora Lead Gen Forms, then “Create or Update Contact” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: It matches on email, so a lead already in HubSpot is updated, not duplicated.

watchOut: “New Lead” is polling, so a lead reaches HubSpot after a scheduled check, not at once.
